comparison: Practical quality/throughput frontier of full LSTM GALAM, full GRU adaptation and local-only LSTM adaptation. Not a pure recurrent-gate causal attribution.
primary_boundary: wnn.chronological-primary.v1; train only fitting, complete official valid reporting

fixed_recipe.precision: fp32; BF16 is a separately implemented and checked future arm
fixed_recipe.batch_status: starting candidate, not profiled or optimal; must pass actual membership/tail checks
fixed_recipe.training_mask: all_after_warmup; receiving-host audit must establish label validity outside is_scored before admission
fixed_recipe.primary_endpoint: configured final epoch5 on full official valid; intermediate epochs diagnostic/exposed

decision_rule.quality_candidate: Descriptive paired mean WP gain>=0.0005 with both seed deltas reported; targeted follow-up required before treating this as a stable recipe gain.
decision_rule.efficiency_candidate: No more than0.0003 descriptive mean WP loss, with >=1.25x measured rows/s at the compared endpoint and honest parameter/budget accounting.
decision_rule.uncertain: Mixed seeds or intermediate results remain inconclusive; a zero-crossing conditional interval alone does not close the mechanism.
decision_rule.partial_or_failure: Infrastructure-censored, NaN, OOM and incomplete fits are separately reported, not zero-valued or negative scientific results.

resource_strategy: Independent one-GPU profiles first; then six paired fits across available L4 slots. Two other slots may run separately bounded engineering profiles/receiving checks. Do not fill cards with duplicate fits or stop existing services. No eight-GPU DDP assumption.
estimate: No measured ETA. Use N_fit*20000*epochs / warmed real_rows_per_second + measured evaluation/checkpoint/startup time; account for shared disk/CPU contention.
followups: LSTM without cell-projection versus GRU at the same3W fusion for more isolated attribution
Measured batch/worker count and FP32/BF16 throughput parity
Plain GRU/GRU+attention and causal EMA-ridge endpoint/ensemble comparisons
admission_blockers: Actual source/component/target indexes and chronological manifest
Reviewed real-shape profile and declared fit budget
